content: Am7e Woosa Leemiso
Yesuusi ba tamaareta azallonna ubba wode woossana mela tamaarsanaw koyidi yaagidi leemiso odis:
“Issi kataman Xoossas yashetonna, asas yeellatonna issi daynni de7ees
He kataman issi am7iya de7awusu. Iyaka, ‘Ta giddoninne ta morkiya giddon de7iya mootuwa pirda’ yaagada ubba wode he daynnaako simeretawusu.
Daynnay guutha wodes I odaa si7onna ixis, shin guyepe ba wozanan, ‘Taani Xoossas yayyonna, asas yeellatonna ixikoka,
ha am7iya tana waaysiya gisho iw pirdana; yaatonna ixiko ubba wode yada tana salethana’ ” yaagidi qopis.
Godayka, “Geella daynnay gidaysa si7ideta;
Xoossay qammanne gallas iyako waassiya ba dooridaysatas pirdeneyee? Entana maaddanaw gam7iyee?
Ta hintew odeysa si7ite, ellesidi pirdana. Gidoshin, Asa Na7i yaa wode sa7a bolla ammano demmandesha?” yaagis.
Farsaawiyanne Qaraxa Qanxisiya Ura
Qassi zaaridi, Yesuusi, bantana xillo asada oothidi ceeqeteysatasinne harata kadheysatas haysada yaagidi leemiso odis:
“Nam7u asati woossanaw Xoossa Keethi bidosona. Issoy Farsaawe hankoy qassi qaraxa qanxisiya asi.
Farsaawey eqidi baw woossishe, ‘Xoossaw taani harata mela bonqancho, geellanne laymatiya asi, aadhada qassi ha qaraxa qanxisiya uraa mela gidonna gisho nena galatayis.
Saamintafe nam7u toho xoomayis, ta demmiyaba ubbaafe asraata kessayis’ yaagis.
“Shin qaraxa qanxiseysi haahon eqidi hari attoshin salo dhoqu gidi xeellanawka yayyidi ba tiraa iccishe ‘Xoossaw, tana nagaranchuwa maararki’ gidi woossis.

Ta hintew odeysa si7ite; Farsaawiyape haysi qaraxa qanxiseysi Xoossaa sinthan xillo gididi ba soo simmis. Ayis giiko, bana dhoqu dhoqu oothiya asi kawuyana, bana kawushiya asi dhoqu dhoqu gaana” yaagis.
Yesuusanne Yooga Nayta
Yesuusi yooga nayta bolla ba kushiya wothidi anjana mela asay iyako ehoosona. Yesuusa tamaareti hessa be7idi “Ayis Yesuusako eheetii?” yaagidi kaccidosona.
Shin Yesuusi nayta baako xeegidi, “Yooga nayti taako yaanaysa diggofite; yo giite. Ayis giiko, Xoossa kawotethay entada hanidaysatasa.
Taani hintew tuma odayis; Xoossa kawotetha yooga naytatho ekonnay oonika yaa gelenna” yaagis.
Dure Ura Oysha
Ayhude halaqatape issoy, “Keeha astamaariyaw, merina de7o demmanaw ay ootho?” yaagidi oychis.
Yesuusi iyako, “Ayis tana keehaw yaagada xeegay? Issi Xoossafe attishin, hari keehi baawa.
Laammofa, wodhopa, kaysotopa, wordo markatofa, ne aawanne ne aayiw boncha” giya kiita eray gidi oychis.
Urayka, “Hessata ubbaa taani na7atethafe doomada naagashe gam7as” yaagis.
Yesuusi hessa si7ida wode, “Hiza, new issibay pacees; new de7iyaba ubbaa bayzada manqotas imma; salon nena shaloy naagees. Yaata simmada, tana kaalla” yaagis.
Shin uray hessa si7ida wode iyaw daro shaloy de7iya gisho daro qiirotis.
Yesuusi uraa be7idi, “Dure asas Xoossa kawotethi geloy waanidi un7andesha?
Durey Xoossa kawotethi gelanaysafe gimaley narpe luhora kantheysi kawuyees” yaagis.
Hessa si7ida asay, “Hessa gidiko ooni attanee?” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi, “Asas danda7etonabay Xoossas danda7etees” yaagis.
Phexroosi, “Heko nuuni nubaa ubbaa aggidi nena kaallida” yaagis.
“Yesuusi tuma ta hintew odayis; Xoossaa kawotethaas gidi ba keethaa woyko ba machiw woyko ba ishata woyko ba aawanne ba aayiw woyko ba nayta aggiday;
ha wodiyan dako daro, yaana alamen merina de7o ekonnay oonika baawa” yaagis.
Yesuusi Ba Hayquwaba Heedzantho Odis
Yesuusi tammanne nam7ata baako xeegidi, “Ane Yerusalaame boos, nabeti Asa Na7aba xaafidaba ubbay yan poletana.
I Ayhude gidonna asaas aadhidi imetana. Enti iya toochana, cayananne iya bolla cuttana.
Iya garaafidaape guye, wodhana, shin heedzantho gallasan I hayqope dendana” yaagis.
Shin iya tamaareti he ubbaafe issibaaka akeekibokona. Iya xuuray entaw qosetida gisho I woygidaako eribookona.
Qooqey Xeellis
Yesuusi Iyaarko matiya wode issi qooqe uray oge gaxan uttidi woossees.
Qooqe uray asay he bessaara aadhishin si7idi, “I aybee?” gidi oychis.
Enti, “Naazirete Yesuusi haysara aadhees” yaagidosona.
I, “Dawita na7aw, Yesuusa, tana maararki” yaagidi waassis.
Sinthe sinthe biya asati, “Si7i ga” gidi hanqetidosona. Shin I, “Dawita na7aw, tana maara” yaagidi darsidi waassis.
Yesuusi eqidi uraa baako ehana mela kiittis. Urayka, iyako shiiqin,
“Ta new ay oothana mela koyay?” yaagidi oychis. Qooqey, “Godaw ta xeellanaw koyayis” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Xeella, ne ammanoy nena pathis” yaagis.
Uray ellesidi xeelli aggis. Xoossaa bonchishe Yesuusa kaallis. Asa ubbay hessa be7idi Xoosse galatidosona.
